name: Courtly Tennis
subtitle: Find players. Plan your hit.
promotionalText: Hit more. Plan less. Find a tennis hit, bring your friends, and sort out the details in one place.
description:
Hit more. Plan less.

Courtly helps adult tennis players find people to play with and get a hit on the calendar. Browse nearby hits, make plans with friends, and keep the conversation together.

FIND YOUR NEXT HIT
See open hits near you or switch to friends’ posts. Sort by closest or soonest, and filter by day, time, distance, level, and format: casual hitting, singles, doubles, or drills. Start with any distance so you can see what’s out there.

MAKE A PLAN
Choose a start time and search for a court, place, or exact address. Check the location on the map, add court details, and choose who can see your hit. Invite friends or let other players ask to join.

KEEP EVERYONE IN THE LOOP
Manage requests and upcoming hits, find friends by name, and coordinate through direct messages, group chats, and hit chats. Optional notifications help you keep up with changes.

PLAY AT YOUR LEVEL
Choose beginner, intermediate, advanced, or competitive, and share the formats you enjoy.

Courtly is for players 18 and older. Availability of hits depends on players in your area. Courtly does not book courts or guarantee court access. Location, contacts, calendar, and notification permissions are optional. You can enter a city or ZIP code manually.
